name: Loving-Kindness (Metta) Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably with your eyes closed, and take several slow breaths to settle in.
Begin by directing loving-kindness toward yourself: "May I be happy. May I be healthy. May I live with ease."
Bring to mind someone you love, and repeat the same phrases for them.
Now picture a neutral person — someone you neither like nor dislike — and offer them the same wishes.
If it feels available, extend the phrases to someone you find difficult, even briefly.
Finish by silently offering the phrases to all beings everywhere, then take a deep breath and open your eyes.
